description: `review-policy --lane TASK_ID` (cli.py's cmd_review_policy, RISK AUTO-CLASSIFY) skips the fleet-wide policy/seat/budget dump and instead prints only which `[review_policy].review_risk_paths` area(s) the lane's diff hits, reading straight off a second git branch (`worktrees.lane_diff` / `mv_engine::lane_diff::lane_diff`) rather than any live Herdr pane. This scenario's lane (see `projects.sandbox.lanes` -- conformance/README.md 'Lane fixtures') only touches `docs/readme.md`, which hits none of the default `DEFAULT_RISK_PATH_GLOBS`/`default_risk_paths()` areas (migration, auth, mcp, deletion, secrets, release) on either side -- no `[review_policy.review_risk_paths]` override is configured here, so both implementations fall back to that same built-in table. Read-only: no Herdr call.
